desc: The M&P22X combines cost-effective shooting with premium features. Designed with superior ergonomics in mind, it offers a slim grip, low recoil, and a crisp, hammer-fired trigger for a superior shooting experience. The 20-round magazine ensures more time on the trigger and less reloading. Optics-ready with a fiber optic front sight, it's adaptable to your shooting needs. A suppressor thread adapter is included in the box, along with a wrench to change it out.
